speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about two months now. It definitely gets worse when I try to walk up a hill, but it doesn't seem to bother me at night. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see the stroke history is noted, but I need to focus on the current respiratory symptoms first. Does the shortness of breath come with wheezing or chest tightness, and have you noticed any blood in your sputum? Additionally, please REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray to evaluate your lung fields.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation with flattened diaphragms, increased retrosternal airspace and a prominent hilar shadow suggestive of emphysema.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with emphysema.
